component_identity.kit_roster_name: ELEGOO UNO R3 Super Starter Kit digital multimeter (or equivalent DMM used with the kit)

primary_sources.claim_scope: Digital multimeter probe socket layout (COM, VΩmA, 10A), and the distinction between voltage, continuity, and current measurement modes; unpowered identification and mode-selection only, no live measurement taken.

orientation: Disconnected conceptual mode-and-socket map; no probe is placed on a live circuit and no measurement is taken.

terminals.name: com_socket
terminals.function: common/ground probe socket, always used for the black probe

terminals.name: v_omega_ma_socket
terminals.function: voltage, resistance, continuity and low-current socket for the red probe

terminals.name: ten_a_socket
terminals.function: dedicated high-current socket for the red probe above the low-current jack's rated limit

terminals.name: mode_dial
terminals.function: selector choosing voltage, continuity, or current measurement mode
